Get Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) data tables

Source: R/get_fars.R
get_fars.Rd

get_fars() returns a FARS data table (e.g. accident, person, or vehicle) for one or more states, an optional county, and one or more years, using the CrashAPI or the zipped data files from the NHTSA downloads site:

Usage

get_fars(
  state = NULL,
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  type = "accident",
  county = NULL,
  source = c("auto", "api", "zip"),
  ...,
  geometry = FALSE,
  crs = NULL,
  decode = c("names", "replace", "labelled", "none"),
  var_labels = c("attribute", "none")
)

Arguments

state

One or more state names, abbreviations, or FIPS numbers. If NULL (default), returns national data. Use "PR" for Puerto Rico.

year

One or more years from 1975 to 2024 (or from 2010 for the CrashAPI). The minimum and maximum values are used as the start and end year, with a message if year has gaps. Defaults to getOption("crashapi.year", 2024).

type

Name of the FARS data table, e.g. "accident" (default), "person", or "vehicle". Lowercase or uppercase values are permitted. The available tables vary by year and source; see get_fars_year() for tables available from the CrashAPI.

county

County name or FIPS number. Requires a single state.

source

Source for the data: "auto" (default), "api" for the CrashAPI, or "zip" for zipped data files.

...

Additional parameters passed to get_fars_zip() when data comes from zipped data files, e.g. path, overwrite, or keep_files.

geometry

If TRUE, return an sf object. Only supported for tables with LATITUDE and LONGITUD columns (e.g. accident).

crs

Coordinate reference system to use if geometry is TRUE.

decode

How to decode coded values using decode_fars(): "names" (default) adds …NAME columns with decoded values where they are missing (data from the CrashAPI and FARS zipped CSV files from 2015 onwards already include them), "replace" replaces codes with factors of decoded values, "labelled" adds value labels with haven::labelled(), and "none" doesn't decode values. See decode_fars() for details.

var_labels

How to add variable labels from fars_vars_labels: "attribute" (default) adds a "label" attribute to each column, which is shown by View() in RStudio and Positron and used by packages such as gt and gtsummary, and "none" doesn't add variable labels.

Value

A data frame, or an sf object if geometry = TRUE. If tables for multiple years from zipped data files can't be combined, a list of data frames named by year.

Details

  • With source = "auto" (default), data for a state from 2010 onwards comes from the CrashAPI with get_fars_year(). National data (state = NULL), data for Puerto Rico (state = "PR"), and data before 2010 comes from zipped data files with get_fars_zip(), which are converted to parquet files and cached so later calls do not download the data again.

  • Data from zipped files is filtered to the requested states and, if needed, a CASEYEAR column is added so the data matches the CrashAPI.

  • If county is provided, tables with a COUNTY column (accident and person) are filtered by county and other tables are filtered to crashes in the county from the accident table (matching ST_CASE and CASEYEAR).

Use get_fars_crashes(), get_fars_cases(), get_fars_crash_list(), or get_fars_summary() to access other CrashAPI endpoints.

Examples

# Person table for Maryland from the CrashAPI
head(get_fars(state = "MD", year = 2022, type = "person"), 5)
